page.overview:
What is Lugia?

This Lugia is a legendary /-type Pokémon that appears in Pokémon The Movie 2000 - The Power of One.

In the movie, Lawrence III wanted to capture Lugia. To accomplish his goal, he set out to enrage and capture the legendary birds. By doing this, Lugia was prophesied to appear to calm them. His plan was then to capture Lugia for his "collection".

Although he ended up injuring it, Lawrence III failed to capture Lugia. With the help of Ash, Lugia was able to stop Lawrence III and calm the birds before the imbalance caused the world's destruction.

Lugia was briefly mentioned in The Mystery is History by Ash and James when they encounter Silver for the first time. Whether this actually makes the movie canon is unknown.
